steps.en: Add the plugin marketplace in Claude Code
steps.zh: 在 Claude Code 里添加插件市场

steps.en: Point it at the target file
Fingerprints the app first — framework, HTTP stack, obfuscation — and stops if it isn't Java/Kotlin
steps.zh: 先做指纹分诊：框架、HTTP 栈、混淆度；不是 Java/Kotlin 就叫停

steps.en: Decompiles with jadx, optionally Fernflower, or both side by side to compare
steps.zh: 用 jadx 反编译，可选 Fernflower，或两者并排对照

steps.en: Rebuilds real Kotlin class names from metadata R8 cannot strip (a.b.c → LoginRepository)
steps.zh: 从元数据重建真实类名（a.b.c → LoginRepository）

steps.en: Sweeps the sources for endpoints, URLs and auth headers across Retrofit/Ktor/Apollo
steps.zh: 扫源码里的端点、URL 与鉴权头（Retrofit/Ktor/Apollo 等）

steps.en: Ask for the flow behind one screen — from LoginActivity to its API calls
steps.zh: 挑一个界面追问调用链：从 LoginActivity 到它的 API 调用

steps.en: Delivers the architecture summary and a two-tier endpoint document
steps.zh: 交付架构摘要与两层端点文档：全量平表加重点深挖

value.en: The app's full API surface documented — hosts, paths, auth — without its source code
value.zh: 没有源码也拿到整份 API 契约：主机、路径、鉴权
